tasks.instruction: The blue tiger character crouches low beside a shallow forest stream, one paw skimming the water while the other steadies balance on a mossy stone, body angled in profile under dappled light.
tasks.visibility_requirement: One hand visible at the water surface; feet obscured by moss and posture.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲在溪边戏水，保持身份与赛璐璐风格。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans back in a worn armchair, ankles crossed on an ottoman, reading a thick novel held up with both paws as warm lamplight falls across the room.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly grip the book edges, all fingers visible; feet partly occluded by ottoman.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在扶手椅上读小说，双手清晰可数。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stretches both arms overhead in a sunlit kitchen, yawning widely while standing on tiptoe near a counter cluttered with fruit bowls and hanging utensils.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both raised hands fully visible with distinct fingers; feet cut off by lower frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在厨房伸展打哈欠，双手完整可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a wooden dock at dawn, gazing at distant mist over a lake, tail curled around one hip and paws resting loosely on its knees.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands rest on knees clearly; one bare foot sole faces camera with four toes visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐在码头看湖，一只脚掌可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a rug to assemble a model airplane, leaning over scattered parts with one paw pinning a wing section and the other holding a tiny glue tube.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible among parts, fingers distinct; feet tucked beneath body and hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎跪地拼模型，双手清楚可辨。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pushes a shopping cart through a busy outdoor market, one paw on the handle and the other reaching toward a stack of ripe melons, body turned mid-stride.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on cart handle and reaching melon; feet in motion, soles not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在市场推车挑瓜，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow garden wall, arms spread wide, one foot forward and the other trailing, with flowering shrubs and a picket fence behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both spread hands clear with fingers; trailing foot sole faces camera showing four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在花园矮墙上平衡行走。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back on a picnic blanket, holding a paper map above its face with both paws while a wicker basket and scattered apples rest beside it.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws grip the map corners clearly; feet outside frame or hidden by blanket.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎仰卧看地图，双手握住地图。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits at a café table writing in a notebook, one paw steadying the page and the other holding a pen, with a steaming cup beside the elbow.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws fully visible on page and pen; feet under table, not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在咖啡馆写笔记，双手清楚。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a low hedge playing hide-and-seek, peeking out with paws parting leaves, one knee bent tightly and the other foot planted behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws part the foliage visibly with distinct fingers; feet behind hedge and hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎躲在树篱后探头，双爪拨叶。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a windowsill during rain, knees drawn up, paw tracing a raindrop on the glass while the other paw hugs a cushion to its chest.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible against glass and cushion; feet folded and occluded.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐窗台看雨，双爪可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pedals a bicycle along a tree-lined path, paws gripping handlebars, body leaning forward, with a basket of bread strapped to the rear rack.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands wrap handlebars with fingers visible; feet on pedals, soles not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎骑车沿林荫道行驶，双手握把。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a low workbench repairing a toaster, one paw inside the casing with a screwdriver and the other holding a small tray of screws.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clearly visible over the workbench; feet hidden below.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在工作台修烤面包机，双手清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands at an easel painting a canvas, one paw dabbing a brush and the other holding a mixing palette smeared with bright colors, apron hanging loose.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws fully shown with palette and brush; feet not in frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在画架前作画，双手持笔与调色板。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger climbs a rope ladder toward a treehouse, both paws grasping rungs above, one foot on a lower rung and tail hanging straight down.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands visible on rungs; one raised foot sole toward camera shows four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎爬绳梯上树屋，手脚可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor wrapping a gift box, one paw folding paper and the other pressing a ribbon bow flat, surrounded by scissors and tape.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible on paper and bow; feet crossed and out of view beneath.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐地上包礼物，双手清晰。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a bathtub scrubbing a rubber duck with a sponge, sleeves rolled, one paw deep in suds and the other bracing on the tub rim.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible above suds and tub rim; feet hidden behind tub.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在浴缸边给小鸭洗澡，双爪可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a hammock strung between two palms, one paw behind its head and the other holding a cold drink, body gently curved.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clear, one behind head and one on the glass; feet hidden by hammock fabric.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎躺在吊床上喝冷饮，双爪可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a sandy beach packing a bucket with a small shovel, one paw scooping sand and the other steadying the pail, waves behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible over bucket; one foot sole faces camera showing four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在沙滩装沙桶，脚掌可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits at a piano bench, both paws poised over the keys mid-chord, sheet music open and a metronome ticking on the lid.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clearly on keyboard with distinct fingers; feet tucked under bench, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐在钢琴前弹奏，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger jogs up a staircase carrying a stack of folded towels, both paws supporting the pile, one foot lifted mid-step on the landing.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible under towel stack; one raised foot sole toward camera shows four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎抱毛巾上楼，脚掌可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a campfire toasting a marshmallow on a long stick, one paw rotating the stick and the other shielding its face from sparks.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible against firelight; feet folded beneath, hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在篝火边烤棉花糖，双爪可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a rocking chair on a porch knitting a long scarf, both paws guiding needles and yarn, a ball of wool at its feet.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clearly hold needles with distinct fingers; feet behind yarn ball, soles hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在门廊摇椅上织围巾，双手清楚。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches in a library aisle pulling a thick book from a low shelf, one paw on the spine and the other bracing the shelf edge.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible on book and shelf; feet hidden by crouching posture.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在图书馆蹲着取书，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies prone on a grassy hill peering through binoculars at birds, both paws gripping the barrels, elbows propped on a folded jacket.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws on binoculars clear; one foot sole raised toward camera showing four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎趴在草坡用望远镜观鸟，脚掌可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a kitchen stool peeling potatoes into a bowl, one paw holding the peeler and the other turning the potato, sleeves pushed up.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws fully visible over the bowl; feet hooked on stool rung, not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐凳上削土豆，双手清楚。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger wades into a shallow pond with a small net, one paw lifting the net and the other holding a jar, water rising around its calves.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clear above water holding net and jar; feet submerged and unseen.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎涉水用网捞东西，双爪可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a park bench feeding crumbs to pigeons, one paw scattering crumbs and the other resting open on its knee, pigeons gathered at its feet.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible, one scattering crumbs; one foot sole turned toward camera shows four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐长椅喂鸽子，脚掌可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a rooftop adjusting a small telescope tripod, both paws tightening knobs, city skyline and dusk clouds behind.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws clearly on tripod knobs; feet hidden by crouch and rooftop ledge.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在屋顶调整望远镜，双手可见。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a wooden crate backstage applying face paint with a small brush, one paw holding a mirror and the other steadying the brush near its cheek.
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both paws visible holding mirror and brush; feet behind crate and unseen.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在后台对着镜子化妆，双手清楚。
